mechanism: Keep two subjects in stable seated geography, establish the first visible speaking turn in a shared frame, give the second subject one compact reply in closer proof, then return to the first subject for a prolonged non-speaking physical reaction. Dialogue meaning may be original instance content, but the reusable source evidence is the turn-pause-reaction timing and shot handoff.

invariants.rule: Establish both subjects and seating geography before singles.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting on isolated close-ups weakens the exchange.

invariants.rule: Keep the second speaking turn compact and visibly complete.
invariants.purpose: Creates a precise visual handoff to the later reaction.
invariants.ablation_failure: An extended turn steals time from the non-speaking reaction.

invariants.rule: Use stable eye lines and prop continuity across cuts.
invariants.purpose: Makes the edit feel like one exchange.

invariants.rule: Return to the first subject for a longer non-speaking physical reaction.
invariants.purpose: Makes performance, not exposition, carry the consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate verbal comeback removes the reaction space.

invariants.rule: End on a changed held posture with no additional speaking turn.
invariants.ablation_failure: Another line restarts the exchange instead of completing the reaction hold.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source tavern-like living room and costumes
source exact drinking and laughter performance
